layouts.name: CResource_Proxy
layouts.notes: On build 17763, CResource::Create allocates 32 bytes and writes the vtable at +0, reference count at +8, IDwmChannel* at +16, and resource handle at +24. CResource::Initialize and WrapExistingResource write the same +16/+24 pair, while CResource::~CResource independently consumes it. The CResource object therefore exposes the proxy view itself before build 18362, so offset 0 is its address rather than a pointer field. Starting with build 18362, offset 2 * sizeof(PVOID) stores a CResourceProxy pointer. CResource::GetProxy must branch before interpreting this storage; reading the pre-18362 offset 0 as CResourceProxy* instead reads the object's vtable pointer.
